turns.assessment: The simultaneous failure of many services whose working ODU paths traverse S21, together with protection switching for services that had viable alternate paths, localizes the event to the OTN layer at S21. O73 directly reports OTN_FABRIC_FAIL at otn.S21 at the same time, while extensive optical power, OSNR, BER, amplifier, and line-interface monitoring showed no corresponding change. This strongly identifies the S21 OTN switch fabric rather than the ROADM or fibre plant.

proposals.rationale: E1 is the OTN switch at S21, common to every affected working path. Its explicit fabric-failure alarm coincides with the mass service interruption, and the unaffected optical telemetry is exactly consistent with an ODU-layer switch failure.

A ROADM port failure at S21 could interrupt multiple channels, but the affected services arrive over many degrees and optical instruments show no signal or power changes. It also does not explain the explicit OTN fabric alarm nearly as well.
